title: The C3-free graph bound for positive Lin-Lu-Yau Ricci curvature
statement:
Let $G$ be a connected $C_3$-free graph. For every edge $xy$ in $G$, suppose that $\kappa_{\textrm{LLY}}(x,y)\geq \kappa>0$.

**The C3-free curvature bound.** Then

$$
|V(G)|\leq 2^{2/\kappa}.
$$

This conjecture extends the proved bound for connected graphs containing neither $C_3$ nor $C_5$ to all connected triangle-free graphs. The stated material does not indicate whether the conjecture has been resolved.
source_name: E. G. K. M. Gamlath, Xiaonan Liu, Linyuan Lu and Xiaofan Yuan, “A tight bound on \C_3,C_5\-free connected graphs with positive Lin-Lu-Yau Ricci curvature”, arXiv:2312.16593 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.16593

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2023).
